author: The Film Theorists
description:
In The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, we get the unexpected surprise of having THE Star Fox Leader, Fox McCloud, as a main character. As we all know, Fox McCloud is all about Barrel Roll… but does he know he’s not actually doing one?
